our_interpretation: The plain reading is that no available driverless system had robustly solved handling the open-ended variety of unusual road situations.
This does not require zero accidents. Conversely, successful service in a restricted operating area does not by itself demonstrate that the broader problem was solved.
Use August 1–19, 2023, for the ongoing state described in the publication month.
criteria.support_condition: Broad evidence covering available systems establishes that robust handling of unforeseen road situations remained unsolved.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An available system is independently shown to handle a representative range of unforeseen real-world situations reliably, without routine human rescue.

evidence.explanation: This documents a difficult emergency-vehicle encounter involving Cruise. The article also reports Cruise's account that its vehicle entered on green and was struck; the collision alone neither assigns fault nor establishes the capability of every system.

Waymo reported established driverless service and improving construction-zone and emergency-scene handling. This is material evidence against interpreting the claim as an inability to handle any unusual situation, but it does not demonstrate a general solution.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A contemporaneous cross-system evaluation with explicit reliability and intervention criteria, or an independently verified system meeting the ordinary broad reading of the claimed capability.
